title: The no-repository refusal sends a profile's author to --repo, which no command takes beside --profile
foundBy: session agent, rendering the example campaign's orientations; the user asked for the fix

evidence.verified: TestAProfileWithNoRepositoryIsSentToReposAlone passes under `go test ./internal/cli/ -count=1`. It drives `validate` and `orientation` on a profile with no repository and finds `under repos:` in both refusals and `--repo` in neither. Making either call site offer `--repo` again fails the test for that command alone. TestTheExampleCampaignValidatesAsTheSpecShows now finds `validate` passing, `orientation` rendering both members and `plan` planning the absent repository as a first commit, with nothing made under HOME. Stripping the example's repositories fails it. The full gate, `make check`, passes.

resolution: A refusal for a profile now says to declare a repository under `repos:`, and only a fleet built from flags is offered `--repo`. The example campaign names one repository at `~/src/report-generator`, for the operator to point at their own checkout. Until that path exists, plan pins an empty first commit, so `validate`, `orientation` and `plan` all run on the example and allocate nothing. SPEC.md's console block shows the passing run. The example names an absolute path because a relative one resolves against the shell's directory, which SAC-094 records.
details:
A campaign whose members have no repository is refused with advice to "pass --repo to give every member the same one". That advice only works for a fleet built from flags. With a profile, `orientation` and `validate` answer `unknown flag: --repo`, and `plan` and `create` answer `--profile is mutually exclusive with fleet flags`. An author holding a profile is sent to a flag that every command refuses.

The example campaign meets the same wall. `testdata/example-campaign/profile.yaml` declares no repository on purpose, so `validate` ends in this refusal, and `orientation` and `plan` cannot render it at all. The example is meant to be the smallest complete campaign, and an author cannot use it to see what a member is told or what create would build.

To reproduce, run `cs-campaign orientation example --profile testdata/example-campaign/profile.yaml`. It prints the refusal. Add `--repo <path>` and it prints `unknown flag: --repo`.
